    Corners of proper quotients (BGRS 1.4) #

    If every proper quotient A/J (J ≠ 0) of A is representation-finite, then so is every proper quotient eAe/I (I ≠ 0) of an idempotent corner: with J = AIA one has eJe = I, and eAe/I ≅ ē(A/J)ē.
